title.narrative: UK international policy for sustainable development

description.narrative:
Objectives of the reports The overall objective of the reports is to contribute to changing the terms of debate on the UK’s approach to sustainable development through ODA and wider international development policy.
The specific objectives are: 1. Show where the current government ODA spend supports, undermines or is neutral to sustainable development outcomes 2. Compare the government's stated international policy commitments on sustainable development to current ODA spending priorities to show coherence and contradictions. 3. Identify ways in which wider foreign policy is / is not aligned on sustainable development 4. Show best practices of a sustainable development approach to ODA where this has happened across donors (NGO, government, international organisation projects). 5. Develop proposals for changes needed in government systems, policies and processes for a sustainable development approach across UK policy and ODA.
